runsheet.short_description: Opening plenary (A6-008, hybrid): run the online topic vote on Dotstorming and take the top 4 topics.
During the plenary and the reconvene, bring the mic to on-site participants who speak.
Create 4 breakout rooms named after the top 4 topics. Open the breakout rooms, allowing participants to choose their room.
Screenshare this notice (in More Info) in the hub. Press 'pause' in the Zoom top bar to freeze the screenshare.
Join your assigned breakout room (one per volunteer). Help people join, make sure someone takes the Room Host role (moderate, keep notes, present conclusions), and keep time.
Run an on-site vote among the top 4 to select 2 on-site topics. Announce each with its room (A6-008, A6-007).
Go to your assigned on-site room (A6-008 or A6-007). Help people find the room, make sure someone takes the Room Host role (moderate, keep notes, present conclusions), and keep time (~45 min).
Introduce yourself to the room as the volunteer, and announce that the group needs a Room Host: someone to moderate, keep notes, and present the conclusions at the reconvene.
Broadcast a 5-minute warning to all breakout rooms; then close the breakout rooms so everyone returns to the hub.
Give your group a 5-minute warning, and make sure the Room Host is ready to present conclusions.
In A6-007: bring the group back to A6-008.
Reconnect A6-008 to the Zoom hub.
Invite each group's Room Host to share conclusions: 4 online and 2 on-site.
Close the session for everyone, on-site and online.
